description: (0.5.0, Draft) Carriage in an evidence bundle and the acdp-trust-report/1 object (RFC-ACDP-0020 §7, §8). Behavioral, consumer-side.

input.golden: trust-001 vector 1 (tenant-acme.production, serial 7, issuer = the sig-003 did:key)

expected.behavior: Adding the golden trust-list body (and its lifecycle_events and receipt) to evidence.contexts of the chain-001 bundle leaves every member of the chain-001 verdict unchanged except evidence_digest, horizon and verdict_digest. horizon becomes max(the old horizon, the list's timed evidence) per RFC-ACDP-0017 §5.4; for chain-001 that is 2026-09-30 → 2026-10-26T00:00:01.000Z. as_of_digest is unchanged. A list whose evidence is no later than the horizon leaves horizon unchanged too.
The verifier reads the trust list from the same bundle and reports per-node outcomes with no network access.
A node whose RFC-ACDP-0017 registry_receipt stage for the pass is not ok is evaluated with no receipt, so an entry with receipt_key_fingerprints gives untrusted_registry (receipt_required).
Two implementations emit byte-identical JCS for the report; report_digest is SHA-256 of the JCS of the report without report_digest (examples/trust-report/golden-trust-report.json).
verdict_digest equals the verdict's own; a report with a different verdict_digest is not applied to that verdict.
Verifying both passes yields two reports, pass latest and pass as_of, each with its own evaluated_at.
An untrusted node changes no chain-verdict member; refusing the chain on it is the consumer's policy.
